original.target_description: Primary original paper could not be acquired within the acquisition allowance. DOI publisher returned a 403 challenge; OpenAlex had no best OA location; author site had a TLS hostname mismatch; CiteSeer alternative returned 404. Original statistics summarized in the replication article were not substituted for the primary paper.

replication.target_description: Study 2: between-participant t test of candy quantity estimates averaged across four containers, single-colored versus pooled varied conditions; 439 complete cases.

n.exclusions: Paper reports excluding estimates beyond mean ±4 SD after an estimate over 4 million; Results group sizes 240 + 199 correspond to t(437). Study reports 439 complete cases.

reported_success.quote: variety resulted in an increase rather than a decrease in perceived quantity

notes: Supplied replication p. 13 is Table 3, not body Results p. 4. Table 3 reports d = -0.217 while body reports -0.218; retained body precision/value. Body calls the N=199 group multicolored even though design includes bicolored sets. Authors call replication of their opposite-direction Study 1 successful, but the original variety-reduces-quantity hypothesis failed. Original study identifier and candy/page locator conflict; original primary unavailable.
